Public Shared Function BuildPcaSummary(model As Multivariate.PCA, rowIds() As Integer, variableNames() As String, matrixLabel As String, retentionLabel As String, retentionValue As Double, hdr As Boolean) As Object(,)
            Dim out(If(hdr, 6, 5), 1) As Object
            Dim r0 As Integer = 0
            If hdr Then
                out(0, 0) = "Setting"
                out(0, 1) = "Value"
                r0 = 1
            End If

            out(r0 + 0, 0) = "Matrix analyzed"
            out(r0 + 0, 1) = matrixLabel
            out(r0 + 1, 0) = "Rows analyzed"

            out(r0 + 2, 0) = "Variables"

            out(r0 + 4, 1) = retentionLabel
            out(r0 + 5, 0) = "Retention value"
            out(r0 + 5, 1) = retentionValue
            Return out
        End Function

source_record.signature: Public Shared Function BuildPcaEigen(eigen() As Double, pct() As Double, cum() As Double, model As Multivariate.PCA, hdr As Boolean) As Object(,)

contracts.whole_body:
Public Shared Function BuildPcaEigen(eigen() As Double, pct() As Double, cum() As Double, model As Multivariate.PCA, hdr As Boolean) As Object(,)
            Dim out(eigen.Length - 1 + If(hdr, 1, 0), 4) As Object
            Dim r0 As Integer = 0
            If hdr Then
                out(0, 0) = "Component"
                out(0, 1) = "Eigenvalue"
                out(0, 2) = "% Variance Explained"
                out(0, 3) = "Cumulative % Explained"
                out(0, 4) = "Retained"
                r0 = 1
            End If

            For i As Integer = 0 To eigen.Length - 1
                out(r0 + i, 0) = "PC" & (i + 1).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
                out(r0 + i, 1) = eigen(i)
                out(r0 + i, 2) = pct(i)
                out(r0 + i, 3) = cum(i)
                out(r0 + i, 4) = (i < model.NoExtractComponents)
            Next
            Return out
        End Function

contracts.whole_body:
Public Shared Function BuildFactorSummary(model As Multivariate.FactorAnalysis, variableNames() As String, matrixLabel As String, extractionLabel As String, rotationLabel As String, scoreLabel As String, hdr As Boolean) As Object(,)
            Dim dataRowCount As Integer = 13

            ' VB array bounds are inclusive, so the upper bound must be:
            '   header row + data rows - 1
            Dim rowUpperBound As Integer = If(hdr, dataRowCount, dataRowCount - 1)

            Dim out(rowUpperBound, 1) As Object
            Dim r0 As Integer = 0

            If hdr Then
                out(0, 0) = "Setting"
                out(0, 1) = "Value"
                r0 = 1
            End If

            out(r0 + 0, 0) = "Matrix analyzed"
            out(r0 + 0, 1) = matrixLabel
            out(r0 + 1, 0) = "Extraction method"
            out(r0 + 1, 1) = extractionLabel
            out(r0 + 2, 0) = "Rotation method"
            out(r0 + 2, 1) = rotationLabel
            out(r0 + 3, 0) = "Score method"
            out(r0 + 3, 1) = scoreLabel
            out(r0 + 4, 0) = "Rows analyzed"
            out(r0 + 4, 1) = model.AnalysisData.GetLength(0)
            out(r0 + 5, 0) = "Rows removed"
            out(r0 + 5, 1) = model.RemovedRowCount
            out(r0 + 6, 0) = "Variables"
            out(r0 + 6, 1) = variableNames.Length
            out(r0 + 7, 0) = "Retained factors"
            out(r0 + 7, 1) = model.NumberOfFactors
            out(r0 + 8, 0) = "Extraction converged"
            out(r0 + 8, 1) = model.ExtractionConverged
            out(r0 + 9, 0) = "Rotation converged"
            out(r0 + 9, 1) = model.RotationConverged
            out(r0 + 10, 0) = "Extraction iterations"
            out(r0 + 10, 1) = model.ExtractionIterations
            out(r0 + 11, 0) = "Rotation iterations"
            out(r0 + 11, 1) = model.RotationIterations
            out(r0 + 12, 0) = "RMSR"
            out(r0 + 12, 1) = model.RMSR
            Return out
        End Function

Public Shared Function BuildFactorEigen(model As Multivariate.FactorAnalysis, ByRef includeHeader As Object, matrixTrace As Func(Of Double(,), Double), readHeader As Func(Of Object, Boolean, Boolean)) As Object(,)
            Dim initialEigen() As Double = model.InitialEigenvalues
            Dim unrotatedSs() As Double = Global.BESHStatNG.WorksheetCompatibility.UdfNumericPreparation38.ColumnSumsOfSquares(model.UnrotatedLoadings, model.UnrotatedLoadings)
            Dim rotatedSs() As Double = Global.BESHStatNG.WorksheetCompatibility.UdfNumericPreparation38.ColumnSumsOfSquares(model.PatternMatrix, model.StructureMatrix)
            Dim totalVar As Double = matrixTrace(model.WorkingMatrix)
            Dim initPct() As Double = Global.BESHStatNG.WorksheetCompatibility.UdfNumericPreparation38.PercentOfTotal(initialEigen, totalVar)
            Dim initCum() As Double = Global.BESHStatNG.WorksheetCompatibility.UdfNumericPreparation38.Cumulative(initPct)
            Dim extrPct() As Double = Global.BESHStatNG.WorksheetCompatibility.UdfNumericPreparation38.PercentOfTotal(unrotatedSs, totalVar)
            Dim extrCum() As Double = Global.BESHStatNG.WorksheetCompatibility.UdfNumericPreparation38.Cumulative(extrPct)
            Dim rotPct() As Double = Global.BESHStatNG.WorksheetCompatibility.UdfNumericPreparation38.PercentOfTotal(rotatedSs, totalVar)
            Dim rotCum() As Double = Global.BESHStatNG.WorksheetCompatibility.UdfNumericPreparation38.Cumulative(rotPct)

            Dim rows As Integer = Math.Max(initialEigen.Length, model.NumberOfFactors)
            Dim hdr As Boolean = readHeader(includeHeader, True)
            Dim out(rows - 1 + If(hdr, 1, 0), 9) As Object
            Dim r0 As Integer = 0
            If hdr Then
                out(0, 0) = "Factor"
                out(0, 1) = "Initial Eigenvalue"
                out(0, 2) = "Initial %"
                out(0, 3) = "Initial Cumulative %"
                out(0, 4) = "Extraction SS Loadings"
                out(0, 5) = "Extraction %"
                out(0, 6) = "Extraction Cumulative %"
                out(0, 7) = "Rotation SS Loadings"
                out(0, 8) = "Rotation %"
                out(0, 9) = "Rotation Cumulative %"
                r0 = 1
            End If

            For i As Integer = 0 To rows - 1
                out(r0 + i, 0) = i + 1
                If i < initialEigen.Length Then
                    out(r0 + i, 1) = initialEigen(i)
                    out(r0 + i, 2) = initPct(i)
                    out(r0 + i, 3) = initCum(i)
                End If
                If i < model.NumberOfFactors Then
                    out(r0 + i, 4) = unrotatedSs(i)
                    out(r0 + i, 5) = extrPct(i)
                    out(r0 + i, 6) = extrCum(i)
                    out(r0 + i, 7) = rotatedSs(i)
                    out(r0 + i, 8) = rotPct(i)
                    out(r0 + i, 9) = rotCum(i)
                End If
            Next
            Return out
        End Function

contracts.whole_body:
Public Shared Function BuildFactorCommunalities(model As Multivariate.FactorAnalysis, variableNames() As String, factorNames() As String, contrib(,) As Double, p As Integer, k As Integer, hdr As Boolean) As Object(,)
            Dim out(p - 1 + If(hdr, 1, 0), k + 3) As Object
            Dim r0 As Integer = 0
            If hdr Then
                out(0, 0) = "Variable"
                out(0, 1) = "Initial"
                For j As Integer = 0 To k - 1
                    out(0, j + 2) = factorNames(j) & " Contribution"
                Next
                out(0, k + 2) = "Extracted"
                out(0, k + 3) = "Uniqueness"
                r0 = 1
            End If

            For i As Integer = 0 To p - 1
                out(r0 + i, 0) = variableNames(i)
                out(r0 + i, 1) = model.InitialCommunalities(i)
                For j As Integer = 0 To k - 1
                    out(r0 + i, j + 2) = contrib(i, j)
                Next
                out(r0 + i, k + 2) = model.Communalities(i)
                out(r0 + i, k + 3) = model.Uniquenesses(i)
            Next
            Return out
        End Function

source_record.signature: Public Shared Function BuildKMeansSummary(model As Multivariate.KMeans, variableNames() As String, initializationMethod As String, distanceMetric As String, standardization As String, missingValuePolicy As String, emptyClusterHandling As String, maxIterations As Integer, tolerance As Double, hdr As Boolean) As Object(,)

contracts.whole_body:
Public Shared Function BuildKMeansSummary(model As Multivariate.KMeans, variableNames() As String, initializationMethod As String, distanceMetric As String, standardization As String, missingValuePolicy As String, emptyClusterHandling As String, maxIterations As Integer, tolerance As Double, hdr As Boolean) As Object(,)
            Dim out(If(hdr, 19, 18), 1) As Object
            Dim r0 As Integer = 0
            If hdr Then
                out(0, 0) = "Setting"
                out(0, 1) = "Value"
                r0 = 1
            End If

            out(r0 + 0, 0) = "Number of clusters"
            out(r0 + 0, 1) = model.Result.NumberOfClusters
            out(r0 + 1, 0) = "Rows analyzed"
            out(r0 + 1, 1) = If(model.Result.ClusterAssignments Is Nothing, 0, model.Result.ClusterAssignments.Length)
            out(r0 + 2, 0) = "Rows removed"
            out(r0 + 2, 1) = If(model.Result.RemovedRowIndices Is Nothing, 0, model.Result.RemovedRowIndices.Length)
            out(r0 + 3, 0) = "Variables"
            out(r0 + 3, 1) = variableNames.Length
            out(r0 + 4, 0) = "Initialization"
            out(r0 + 4, 1) = initializationMethod
            out(r0 + 5, 0) = "Distance metric"
            out(r0 + 5, 1) = distanceMetric
            out(r0 + 6, 0) = "Standardization"
            out(r0 + 6, 1) = standardization
            out(r0 + 7, 0) = "Missing-value policy"
            out(r0 + 7, 1) = missingValuePolicy
            out(r0 + 8, 0) = "Empty-cluster handling"
            out(r0 + 8, 1) = emptyClusterHandling
            out(r0 + 9, 0) = "Random starts evaluated"
            out(r0 + 9, 1) = model.Result.StartsEvaluated
            out(r0 + 10, 0) = "Max iterations per start"
            out(r0 + 10, 1) = maxIterations

contracts.whole_body:
Public Shared Function BuildHierarchicalSummary(model As Multivariate.HierarchicalClustering, variableNames() As String, linkage As String, distanceMetric As String, minkowskiPower As Double, standardization As String, missingValuePolicy As String, mergeSteps As Integer, ByRef finalHeight As Object, hdr As Boolean) As Object(,)
            Dim out(If(hdr, 11, 10), 1) As Object
            Dim r0 As Integer = 0
            If hdr Then
                out(0, 0) = "Setting"
                out(0, 1) = "Value"
                r0 = 1
            End If

            out(r0 + 0, 0) = "Linkage"
            out(r0 + 0, 1) = linkage
            out(r0 + 1, 0) = "Distance metric"
            out(r0 + 1, 1) = distanceMetric
            out(r0 + 2, 0) = "Minkowski power"
            out(r0 + 2, 1) = minkowskiPower
            out(r0 + 3, 0) = "Standardization"
            out(r0 + 3, 1) = standardization
            out(r0 + 4, 0) = "Missing-value policy"
            out(r0 + 4, 1) = missingValuePolicy
            out(r0 + 5, 0) = "Rows analyzed"
            out(r0 + 5, 1) = If(model.Result.ActiveRowIndices Is Nothing, 0, model.Result.ActiveRowIndices.Length)
            out(r0 + 6, 0) = "Rows removed"
            out(r0 + 6, 1) = If(model.Result.RemovedRowIndices Is Nothing, 0, model.Result.RemovedRowIndices.Length)
            out(r0 + 7, 0) = "Variables"
            out(r0 + 7, 1) = variableNames.Length
            out(r0 + 8, 0) = "Merge steps"
            out(r0 + 8, 1) = mergeSteps
            out(r0 + 9, 0) = "Leaf count"
            out(r0 + 9, 1) = If(model.Result.ActiveRowIndices Is Nothing, 0, model.Result.ActiveRowIndices.Length)
            out(r0 + 10, 0) = "Final merge height"
            out(r0 + 10, 1) = finalHeight
            Return out
        End Function

contracts.whole_body:
Public Shared Function BuildCaSummary(model As Multivariate.CA, eigen() As Double, hdr As Boolean) As Object(,)
            Dim out(If(hdr, 6, 5), 1) As Object
            Dim r0 As Integer = 0
            If hdr Then
                out(0, 0) = "Setting"
                out(0, 1) = "Value"
                r0 = 1
            End If

            out(r0 + 0, 0) = "Analysis type"
            out(r0 + 0, 1) = "Simple correspondence analysis"
            out(r0 + 1, 0) = "Row categories"
            out(r0 + 1, 1) = model.rowNames.Length
            out(r0 + 2, 0) = "Column categories"
            out(r0 + 2, 1) = model.ColumNames.Length
            out(r0 + 3, 0) = "Available axes"
            out(r0 + 3, 1) = If(eigen Is Nothing, 0, eigen.Length)
            out(r0 + 4, 0) = "Total inertia"
            out(r0 + 4, 1) = If(eigen Is Nothing, CType(Nothing, Object), CType(eigen.Sum(), Object))
            out(r0 + 5, 0) = "Interpretation"
            out(r0 + 5, 1) = "Rows and columns are analyzed jointly through chi-square distances."
            Return out
        End Function

contracts.whole_body:
Public Shared Function BuildClusterPreprocessingTable(varNames() As String, locations() As Double, scales() As Double,
                                                        mode As Multivariate.ClusterStandardizationMode) As UdfReportProjection38
            Dim varCount As Integer = 0
            If varNames IsNot Nothing Then
                varCount = varNames.Length
            ElseIf locations IsNot Nothing Then
                varCount = locations.Length
            ElseIf scales IsNot Nothing Then
                varCount = scales.Length
            End If

            If mode = Multivariate.ClusterStandardizationMode.None OrElse varCount <= 0 Then
                Dim note(1, 1) As Object
                note(0, 0) = "Setting"
                note(0, 1) = "Value"
                note(1, 0) = "Standardization"
                note(1, 1) = "None"
                Return New UdfReportProjection38(New Global.BESHStatNG.ResultTableOutputModel(note), UdfReportPreparation38.Raw)
            End If

            Dim out(varCount, 2) As Object
            out(0, 0) = "Variable"
            out(0, 1) = "Location"
            out(0, 2) = "Scale"
            For i As Integer = 0 To varCount - 1
                out(i + 1, 0) = If(varNames IsNot Nothing AndAlso i < varNames.Length, CType(varNames(i), Object), CType("X" & (i + 1).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture), Object))
                out(i + 1, 1) = If(locations IsNot Nothing AndAlso i < locations.Length, CType(locations(i), Object), CType(Nothing, Object))
                out(i + 1, 2) = If(scales IsNot Nothing AndAlso i < scales.Length, CType(scales(i), Object), CType(Nothing, Object))
            Next
            Return New UdfReportProjection38(New Global.BESHStatNG.ResultTableOutputModel(out), UdfReportPreparation38.Raw)
        End Function

source_record.signature: Public Shared Function BuildRemovedRowsOutput(rowIds() As Integer, rowLabels() As String) As UdfReportProjection38

contracts.whole_body:
Public Shared Function BuildRemovedRowsOutput(rowIds() As Integer, rowLabels() As String) As UdfReportProjection38
            If rowIds Is Nothing OrElse rowIds.Length = 0 Then
                Dim note(1, 1) As Object
                note(0, 0) = "Setting"
                note(0, 1) = "Value"
                note(1, 0) = "Removed rows"
                note(1, 1) = "None"
                Return New UdfReportProjection38(New Global.BESHStatNG.ResultTableOutputModel(note), UdfReportPreparation38.Raw)
            End If

            Dim hasLabels As Boolean = (rowLabels IsNot Nothing AndAlso rowLabels.Length = rowIds.Length)
            Dim out(rowIds.Length, If(hasLabels, 2, 1)) As Object
            out(0, 0) = "OriginalRow"
            If hasLabels Then
                out(0, 1) = "RowLabel"
                out(0, 2) = "Reason"
            Else
                out(0, 1) = "Reason"
            End If

            For i As Integer = 0 To rowIds.Length - 1
                out(i + 1, 0) = rowIds(i)
                If hasLabels Then
                    out(i + 1, 1) = rowLabels(i)
                    out(i + 1, 2) = "Removed before fitting because at least one analysis variable was missing or non-finite."
                Else
                    out(i + 1, 1) = "Removed before fitting because at least one analysis variable was missing or non-finite."
                End If
            Next
            Return New UdfReportProjection38(New Global.BESHStatNG.ResultTableOutputModel(out), UdfReportPreparation38.Raw)
        End Function

Public Shared Function BuildRemovedRowsOutput(rowIds() As Integer, rowLabels() As String) As UdfReportProjection38
            If rowIds Is Nothing OrElse rowIds.Length = 0 Then
                Dim note(1, 1) As Object
                note(0, 0) = "Setting"
                note(0, 1) = "Value"
                note(1, 0) = "Removed rows"
                note(1, 1) = "None"
                Return New UdfReportProjection38(New Global.BESHStatNG.ResultTableOutputModel(note), UdfReportPreparation38.Raw)
            End If

            Dim hasLabels As Boolean = (rowLabels IsNot Nothing AndAlso rowLabels.Length = rowIds.Length)
            Dim out(rowIds.Length, If(hasLabels, 2, 1)) As Object
            out(0, 0) = "OriginalRow"
            If hasLabels Then
                out(0, 1) = "RowLabel"
                out(0, 2) = "Reason"
            Else
                out(0, 1) = "Reason"
            End If

            For i As Integer = 0 To rowIds.Length - 1
                out(i + 1, 0) = rowIds(i)
                If hasLabels Then
                    out(i + 1, 1) = rowLabels(i)
                    out(i + 1, 2) = "Removed before fitting because at least one analysis variable was missing or non-finite."
                Else
                    out(i + 1, 1) = "Removed before fitting because at least one analysis variable was missing or non-finite."
                End If
            Next
            Return New UdfReportProjection38(New Global.BESHStatNG.ResultTableOutputModel(out), UdfReportPreparation38.Raw)
        End Function

Public Shared Function BuildHierarchicalLeafOrderTable(result As Multivariate.HierarchicalClusterResult) As UdfReportProjection38
            If result Is Nothing Then Return Nothing

            Dim n As Integer = If(result.ActiveRowIndices Is Nothing, 0, result.ActiveRowIndices.Length)
            Dim out(Math.Max(n, 1), 2) As Object
            out(0, 0) = "DisplayOrder"
            out(0, 1) = "OriginalRow"
            out(0, 2) = "RowLabel"
            If n = 0 Then
                out(1, 0) = 1
                out(1, 1) = Nothing
                out(1, 2) = Nothing
                Return New UdfReportProjection38(New Global.BESHStatNG.ResultTableOutputModel(out), UdfReportPreparation38.Raw)
            End If

            Dim labelByRow As New Dictionary(Of Integer, String)
            If result.ActiveRowLabels IsNot Nothing AndAlso result.ActiveRowLabels.Length = n Then
                For i As Integer = 0 To n - 1
                    labelByRow(result.ActiveRowIndices(i)) = result.ActiveRowLabels(i)
                Next
            End If

            Dim displayOrder() As Integer = If(result.LeafOrder IsNot Nothing AndAlso result.LeafOrder.Length = n,
                                               result.LeafOrder,
                                               result.ActiveRowIndices)
            For i As Integer = 0 To n - 1
                Dim rowId As Integer = displayOrder(i)
                out(i + 1, 0) = i + 1
                out(i + 1, 1) = rowId
                out(i + 1, 2) = If(labelByRow.ContainsKey(rowId), CType(labelByRow(rowId), Object), CType("Obs " & rowId.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture), Object))
            Next
            Return New UdfReportProjection38(New Global.BESHStatNG.ResultTableOutputModel(out), UdfReportPreparation38.Raw)
        End Function

contracts.whole_body:
Public Shared Function BuildCaEigenOutput(model As Multivariate.CA, includeHeader As Boolean) As UdfReportProjection38
            If model Is Nothing OrElse model.Eigenvalues Is Nothing Then Return UdfReportProjection38.FromFault(UdfReportFault38.NotAvailable)
            Dim eigen() As Double = model.Eigenvalues
            Dim pct(,) As Double = model.Percents
            Dim out(eigen.Length - 1 + If(includeHeader, 1, 0), 3) As Object
            Dim r0 As Integer = 0
            If includeHeader Then
                out(0, 0) = "Axis"
                out(0, 1) = "Inertia"
                out(0, 2) = "% Inertia"
                out(0, 3) = "Cumulative % Inertia"
                r0 = 1
            End If

            For i As Integer = 0 To eigen.Length - 1
                out(r0 + i, 0) = "Dim " & (i + 1).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
                out(r0 + i, 1) = eigen(i)
                out(r0 + i, 2) = pct(i, 0)
                out(r0 + i, 3) = pct(i, 1)
            Next

            Return New UdfReportProjection38(New Global.BESHStatNG.ResultTableOutputModel(out), UdfReportPreparation38.NormalizeBlanks)
        End Function

contracts.whole_body:
Public Shared Function BuildCaOverviewOutput(idHeader As String,
                                               names() As String,
                                               quality() As Double,
                                               mass() As Double,
                                               distance() As Double,
                                               inertia() As Double,
                                               includeHeader As Boolean) As UdfReportProjection38
            Dim n As Integer = names.Length
            Dim out(n - 1 + If(includeHeader, 1, 0), 4) As Object
            Dim r0 As Integer = 0
            If includeHeader Then
                out(0, 0) = idHeader
                out(0, 1) = "Quality"
                out(0, 2) = "Mass"
                out(0, 3) = "Distance"
                out(0, 4) = "Inertia"
                r0 = 1
            End If

            For i As Integer = 0 To n - 1
                out(r0 + i, 0) = names(i)
                out(r0 + i, 1) = quality(i)
                out(r0 + i, 2) = mass(i)
                out(r0 + i, 3) = distance(i)
                out(r0 + i, 4) = inertia(i)
            Next

            Return New UdfReportProjection38(New Global.BESHStatNG.ResultTableOutputModel(out), UdfReportPreparation38.NormalizeBlanks)
        End Function

source_record.name: ResolveAvailableAxisCount
source_record.signature: Public Shared Function ResolveAvailableAxisCount(preferredAxisCount As Integer, valueSelector As Func(Of Integer, Double())) As Integer

contracts.whole_body:
Public Shared Function ResolveAvailableAxisCount(preferredAxisCount As Integer, valueSelector As Func(Of Integer, Double())) As Integer
            If preferredAxisCount < 1 OrElse valueSelector Is Nothing Then Return 0
            Dim available As Integer = 0
            For axisIdx As Integer = 0 To preferredAxisCount - 1
                Try
                    Dim values() As Double = valueSelector(axisIdx)
                    If values Is Nothing Then Exit For
                    available += 1
                Catch ex As Exception
                    Exit For
                End Try
            Next
            Return available
        End Function

contracts.whole_body:
Public Shared Function BuildCaAxisMetricOutput(idHeader As String, names() As String, axisPrefix As String,
                                                 axisCount As Integer, valueSelector As Func(Of Integer, Double()),
                                                 includeHeader As Boolean) As UdfReportProjection38
            Dim effectiveAxisCount As Integer = ResolveAvailableAxisCount(axisCount, valueSelector)
            If effectiveAxisCount < 1 Then Return UdfReportProjection38.FromFault(UdfReportFault38.NotAvailable)

            Dim n As Integer = names.Length
            Dim out(n - 1 + If(includeHeader, 1, 0), effectiveAxisCount) As Object
            Dim r0 As Integer = 0

            If includeHeader Then
                out(0, 0) = idHeader
                For j As Integer = 0 To effectiveAxisCount - 1
                    out(0, j + 1) = axisPrefix & (j + 1).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
                Next
                r0 = 1
            End If

            For i As Integer = 0 To n - 1
                out(r0 + i, 0) = names(i)
            Next

            For j As Integer = 0 To effectiveAxisCount - 1
                Dim values() As Double = valueSelector(j)
                For i As Integer = 0 To n - 1
                    out(r0 + i, j + 1) = values(i)
                Next
            Next
            Return New UdfReportProjection38(New Global.BESHStatNG.ResultTableOutputModel(out), UdfReportPreparation38.NormalizeBlanks)
        End Function

Public Shared Function BuildCaseMatrixOutput(idHeader As String, rowIds() As Integer,
                                              colNames() As String, mat(,) As Double, includeHeader As Boolean) As UdfReportProjection38
            If mat Is Nothing OrElse rowIds Is Nothing Then Return UdfReportProjection38.FromFault(UdfReportFault38.NotAvailable)

            Dim n As Integer = mat.GetLength(0)
            Dim p As Integer = mat.GetLength(1)
            Dim out(n - 1 + If(includeHeader, 1, 0), p) As Object
            Dim r0 As Integer = 0

            If includeHeader Then
                out(0, 0) = idHeader
                For j As Integer = 0 To p - 1
                    out(0, j + 1) = If(colNames IsNot Nothing AndAlso j < colNames.Length, colNames(j), (j + 1).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture))
                Next
                r0 = 1
            End If

            For i As Integer = 0 To n - 1
                out(r0 + i, 0) = rowIds(i)
                For j As Integer = 0 To p - 1
                    out(r0 + i, j + 1) = mat(i, j)
                Next
            Next

            Return New UdfReportProjection38(New Global.BESHStatNG.ResultTableOutputModel(out), UdfReportPreparation38.NormalizeBlanks)
        End Function
